title: Mayan Mishap
description: Created by Tango, Mayan Mishap is a high-difficulty, five-level PWAD featuring a distinct Mayan setting. Built from refined speedmapped layouts, the WAD features a custom palette, new weapon sprites and sounds, and DeHackEd alterations. Monster behavior is reworked with faster projectiles and movement speeds, along with custom enemies like the flying greater mancubus and cyber baron.
